decisionBasis: No open P0/P1 findings. The three prior P1 findings are closed by the current composition implementation and by independent in-memory attack-fixture execution. This decision does not promote PARTIAL/SELF_CHECK evidence or qualify any external system.

findings.evidence: canonicalParticipantForOperation derives requester/creator from the Current Request for every operation, including SUBMIT_REQUEST, CREATE_MILESTONE, START_MILESTONE, and MARK_DELIVERY_PENDING. validateAuthority rejects a context principal that differs from that role and rejects any authority actor that differs from the same canonical role. Independent fixture: an unrelated active tenant member was rejected for all four target operations (4/4).

After apply and immediately before commit, resolveCommitMembership re-resolves Current Membership and compares active status, membershipId, principalId, tenantId, and membershipRevision. Work420CommitInput carries this identity; the fixture commit repeats the comparison before mutation (fixture.ts:564-610). Independent fixture revoked membership during resolveAuthority: execute returned SERVER_CONTEXT_INVALID, aggregate identity/state were unchanged, and commitCount remained 0.

verifyCurrentAggregate validates the canonical envelope then compares request, quote, agreement, milestone, delivery, acceptance, rights, payment, and ledger current heads against envelope ref.revision before authority resolution. Existing test covers downstream stale-head operations (composition.test.ts:909-1047); independent fixture completed the full chain and substituted each of the nine heads. All 9/9 were rejected with STALE_CURRENT_RECORD without aggregate-version mutation.
